COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.

BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-12 commit c615faa. 26 content files + 8 ADRs. Methodology v1.3. STAGES DONE THROUGH 18. Spine: 19 stages (18 + inserted 16.5).

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST. v1.3 added CONTEXTUAL QUESTION PRINCIPLE, PARALLEL-TEXT CONTROL, TWO-AXIS DISTINCTION for clean food.

STAGE 18 = 00s-clean-and-unclean-from-noah-to-messiah.md. NO VERDICT REACHED — ends with an evidence-standing table and SIX unresolved items. That is deliberate and is the honest state.

TRACED FROM NOAH: Gen 7:2 tahor / lo tehorah PREDATE SINAI (2nd consecutive institution to do so). BRAKE: Genesis does NOT say Noah observed Leviticus 11. Gen 8:20 — FIRST EXPLICIT FUNCTION IS SACRIFICIAL. Three-part precision: distinction explicit / sacrifice link explicit / DIETARY PROHIBITION NOT YET EXPLICIT.

GENESIS 9:3 IS A REAL DIFFICULTY, RECORDED NOT EXPLAINED AWAY: 'every moving thing that lives shall be food for you... I give you everything.' Strong objection to any universal pre-Sinai DIETARY reading. IT STANDS. Then 9:4 restricts BLOOD — given to NOAH i.e. humanity broadly, NOT Israel (jurisdiction datum; reappears at Acts 15:20/29).

Exodus 19:5-6 frames Leviticus — Israel constituted QADOSH/set apart (CJB renders 'set apart' outright). LEVITICUS 11:7-8 EXPLICIT: Torah prohibits Israel from eating pig. Not inference, not tradition. 'Unclean TO you' raises jurisdiction question — ontological for all humanity, or holiness boundary for Israel? Genesis prevents saying the category began with Israel; Leviticus clearly applies legislation to Israel. BOTH STAND; UNRESOLVED. LEVITICUS 11:44-47 SUPPLIES ITS OWN STATED REASON: holiness -> separation -> distinction -> relationship with Yahweh. Deut 14:2-3 repeats independently. Reducing to nutrition advice CONTRADICTS the text's stated purpose.

ISAIAH 65:4 / 66:17 CUT BOTH WAYS, both recorded: pig-eating sits inside rebellion/judgment language so 'the Prophets treat this as insignificant' is FALSE — but the passages also involve pagan ritual so 'Isaiah damns anyone eating bacon' is NOT what they say.

MARK 7 — SHARPEST FINDING OF THE STAGE:
Dispute identified FIRST = unwashed hands, n'tilat-yadayim, tradition of the elders. MARK 7:8 IS THE CONTROL VERSE — Yeshua criticizing people for SETTING ASIDE God's commands for human tradition; any reading of v.19 must survive standing next to v.8.
MARK 7:19 GREEK = katharizon panta ta bromata, 'cleansing all the foods' — A PARTICIPLE WITH NO STATED SUBJECT. FOUR TRANSLATIONS, FOUR DEGREES OF INTERPRETATION: ESV 'he declared' / NIV 'Jesus declared' / CJB 'he declared all foods RITUALLY clean' (adds scope-narrowing adverb) / RVR1960 'haciendo limpios' KEEPS THE PARTICIPLE AND SUPPLIES NOTHING. The historical digestive-process reading is grammatically available precisely because the participle has no subject. INTEREST NOTED BOTH DIRECTIONS AND SETTLES NOTHING: CJB is Messianic Jewish (stake in narrow), ESV/NIV traditional-Christian (stake in broad). SECOND QUESTION SURVIVES EVEN IF DECLARATIVE READING IS RIGHT: what does BROMATA denote — every organism is now food, or things already classified as food can't defile via ritual hand contamination? NOT identical claims. Open q 29.
MATTHEW 15:20 = PARALLEL-TEXT CONTROL — far narrower, and MATTHEW HAS NO PARENTHESIS AT ALL.

ACTS 10-11: Peter as CHRONOLOGICAL WITNESS — years after Mark 7 his reflexive answer is he's never eaten anything common or unclean (10:14). Acts 10:17 he is 'INWARDLY PERPLEXED' — Luke does not show him reaching a dietary conclusion. Acts 10:28 + 10:34-35 Peter supplies his OWN interpretation: not any PERSON common or unclean. VERY HIGH CONFIDENCE the vision's primary narrative purpose is Gentile inclusion — and it's LUKE who places that interpretation in the text.
BUT BRAKE RUNS BOTH WAYS: do NOT move from 'primarily about people' to 'therefore no food implication whatsoever' (Anti-Replacement). The vision USES food categories; the command really is kill-and-eat. Any dietary implication requires ADDITIONAL evidence. Precise position, neither more nor less.
ACTS 11 GAP — USER'S OWN CATCH, preserved as a worked observation/inference demonstration: objection is TABLE FELLOWSHIP with uncircumcised, and LUKE NEVER SAYS WHAT WAS ON THE TABLE. 'Peter ate unclean animals at Cornelius's house' = INFERENCE, UNSUPPORTED BY NARRATIVE. Inserting one would be especially poor method right after 10:14. Had Luke wanted the double meaning, this is exactly where he'd have supplied it. He doesn't.
PRECISION: Luke does NOT use 'the promise' at Acts 11:18 — connecting to the Abrahamic promise is an intertextual conclusion (well-supported by Gen 12:3, Gal 3, Rom 11, Eph 2, but not Luke's word there).

ACTS 15 reconnects to Noah — blood prohibition of Gen 9:4 reappears in the one list handed to Gentiles. Lev 17-18 ger laws are a second proposal; NOT mutually exclusive. BUT do NOT announce 'Acts 15 is the Noahide laws' — text doesn't say that. BOTH SILENCES PRESERVED: Acts 15 does NOT say 'do not eat pork' AND does NOT say 'you may now eat everything Leviticus prohibited.' Acts 15 alone can't settle it. Open q 32.

ROMANS 14 — TWO PROBLEMS: (1) 14:2 'the weak person eats only VEGETABLES' (lachana) BLOCKS the standard Torah-Jew-vs-Christian reading — TORAH NEVER REQUIRED JEWS TO EAT ONLY VEGETABLES, so at least one party's practice extends well beyond avoiding unclean species. Paul's instruction is SYMMETRICAL (14:3) — neither party told to change. (2) 14:14 uses KOINOS not AKATHARTOS. koinos = common/profane/defiled-by-association; akathartos = LXX term for inherently unclean animals. PETER DISTINGUISHES THEM IN ONE BREATH at Acts 10:14 'common OR unclean'. English flattens both; Greek does not. LIVE LEXICAL QUESTION, not a conclusion either way. Open q 30. Five candidate explanations for the Roman dispute tabled none selected: idol-meat / unknown preparation-provenance / ritual contamination / ASCETIC PRACTICE / community scruples. Chapter also concerns esteeming DAYS, complicating any purely-dietary reading.

THREE NEW INSTRUMENTS:
1. CONTEXTUAL QUESTION PRINCIPLE — 'Before using a passage as evidence, identify the question/controversy/situation the author was ACTUALLY addressing. Implications beyond that context must be DEMONSTRATED, not assumed.' STATED IN THE USER'S OWN WORDS ('don't ask a verse to answer a question its author wasn't necessarily addressing') and elevated because it had been operating unnamed for several stages. Distinct from Category Collapse: that asks whether OUR question is well-formed, this asks what THE AUTHOR'S question was. Applied 3x: Mark 7 = unwashed hands / Acts 10-11 = Gentile inclusion / Romans 14 = under investigation.
2. PARALLEL-TEXT CONTROL — narrower Gospel summary constrains the other's ambiguous clause.
3. TWO-AXIS DISTINCTION for 'clean food': AXIS 1 species classification vs AXIS 2 preparation/provenance/condition (how killed, blood handled, idol-offered, diseased, conscience). INDEPENDENT. A Torah-clean cow can fail every Axis-2 question; an immaculately-raised animal can still be Axis-1 unclean. User's modern concerns (slaughter, processing, vaccination, provenance) sit almost entirely on AXIS 2 — a real and biblically-recognized category (Gen 9:4 blood, Acts 15 strangled/idol-meat, 1 Cor 8-10) — BUT NOT THE SAME QUESTION AS SPECIES.

GLOSSARY ADDED: asceticism (askesis = exercise/training; voluntary self-denial as spiritual discipline; NOT about slaughter method); koinos/akathartos distinction.

EVIDENCE STANDING: HIGH = categories predate Sinai / first Genesis use is sacrificial / Leviticus explicitly prohibits + ties to holiness / Mark 7 controversy begins with unwashed hands / Peter years later says never eaten common-or-unclean. VERY HIGH = Acts 10's explicit primary interpretation concerns PERSONS. UNRESOLVED = whether Mark 7 nevertheless changes dietary status / whether Acts 10 carries secondary dietary implication / what Romans 14's controversy concerns / what Acts 15:21 means for ongoing Gentile instruction / whether Gen 9:3 included already-unclean species / whether Leviticus's 'unclean TO you' is ontological or covenantally scoped.

NEXT: SHORT HISTORICAL/EXEGETICAL INVESTIGATION — WHAT WAS ACTUALLY HAPPENING AT THE ROMAN TABLE? What does 'the weak eats only vegetables' most plausibly refer to? DELIBERATELY PLACED BEFORE 1 Corinthians 8-10, because identifying the dispute makes Romans 14 much harder to weaponize in EITHER direction. THEN: 1 Corinthians 8-10 / Colossians 2:16-23 / 1 Timothy 4:1-5. 1 TIM 4 PROBLEM STATED IN ADVANCE: 4:4 'everything created by God is good, nothing to be rejected' sounds devastating ISOLATED, but 4:3 says 'foods that God created to be received with thanksgiving' — so does 'everything created' mean every organism is now food, or things already understood as bromata? AND NOTE THE OPPONENTS' PROFILE: they FORBID MARRIAGE and require abstinence — an ASCETIC target, not a Levitical one. Observation about the passage, not yet an argument.
